concerns.text: Only 10 independent runs per variant per environment (total 60 runs) are planned. This sample size is likely under‑powered for detecting the ≥ 80 % performance‑retention claim (SC‑001) and the ≥ 60 % cost‑reduction claim (SC‑002) with reasonable statistical power (≥ 0.8). A formal power analysis should be performed and the number of runs increased accordingly.

The plan relies on GitHub Actions matrix jobs but does not explicitly control for runner‑to‑runner variability (e.g., background load, CPU frequency scaling). Such uncontrolled hardware differences can confound per‑step CPU‑time measurements, threatening the validity of SC‑002. The methodology should include steps to pin the runner environment (e.g., using self‑hosted runners or specifying exact VM images) or to record and adjust for any observed hardware variance.

concerns.location: plan.md:Student‑Only Heuristic Fidelity (Principle VII) & Research – Methodology
concerns.text: The construct validity of the student‑only heuristic (entropy Hₜ and stability Sₜ) as a surrogate for the teacher‑student confidence gap is assumed but not empirically justified before the main study. A pilot analysis confirming that Hₜ and Sₜ correlate with the teacher‑student gap (or with token correctness) should be conducted and reported, otherwise the Pearson‑r requirement (SC‑005) may be testing a poorly defined construct.
